name: Hanaa Idris
title: Clinical Psychologist
description: Hanaa is an endorsed clinical psychologist who is passionate about working with clients from diverse backgrounds. She is trained and experienced in a range of treatment methods including Trauma Focused Cognitive Behaviour Therapy (TFCBT), CBT, DBT and ACT.

name: Brad Rooney
title: Registered Psychologist
description: Brad is also passionate about addressing and providing support for the unique challenges faced by the LGBTQIA+ community. His areas of interest include anxiety disorders, mood disorders, adjustment, stress, interpersonal and relationship difficulties; he is particularly interested in providing awareness and support to the LGBTIQA+ community. Also conducts ADHD and Autism assessments; CBT-E for eating disorders.
specialties: LGBTIQA+, anxiety, eating disorders, ADHD/autism assessment

name: Dr Daniel Reich
title: Clinical Psychologist
description: As an integrative clinician, Daniel draws on various therapeutic models, including Schema Therapy, CBT, narrative therapy, and existential therapy. He helps individuals see mental health as part of a broader personal history that can be understood and emotionally processed, and looks beyond presenting issues to personality development. Moonee Ponds (telehealth also available).
specialties: schema therapy, existential, oncology, young adults

name: Sky Mutch
title: Registered Psychologist
description: Sky has experience working across the lifespan with individuals aged 17 and above, with different cultural backgrounds, sexual orientations/identifications and presentations such as depression, anxiety, stress, ADHD support, relationship problems, anger and self-esteem. Moonee Ponds clinic; Wednesdays via telehealth.

name: Saliha Kuru
title: Clinical Psychologist
description: Saliha holds a Master's degree in Clinical Psychology with clinical endorsement and supports children, adolescents, adults and older adults, drawing on CBT, DBT skills, ACT skills, schema-informed principles and solution-focused therapies.

name: Lee Sepe
title: Registered Psychologist
description: Lee draws on CBT, ACT, Eye Movement Desensitisation and Reprocessing (EMDR), DBT, and principles from Schema Therapy. His integrative and flexible style allows him to support clients in processing past experiences and creating sustainable, positive change. Works with adults; Medicare, private and NDIS.

name: Amy Crosby
title: Registered Psychologist
description: Amy is a Registered Psychologist who is trauma-informed and neuro-affirming. Approaches include Eye Movement Desensitisation and Reprocessing (EMDR) and CBT for Insomnia. Particular interest in children (3-10), adults and older adults, including perinatal mental health and insomnia. Moonee Ponds (telehealth also available); NDIS, TAC, WorkCover.

name: Lucas Roelandt
title: Registered Psychologist
description: Lucas has a particular interest in supporting young people (10+) and adults experiencing anxiety, trauma, anger management difficulties, and substance use concerns, and supports neurodivergent individuals with an affirming approach. Approaches include Eye Movement Desensitization and Reprocessing (EMDR). Moonee Ponds (telehealth also available).
specialties: EMDR, trauma, youth justice, neurodivergent, substance use
